problem.passage:
The graph shows a linear function $f$ that models the water level, in inches, of a tank $x$ hours after a drainage valve is opened.

What is the value of $f(0)$?
problem.stimulus: The graph shows a linear function $f$ that models the water level, in inches, of a tank $x$ hours after a drainage valve is opened.
problem.question: What is the value of $f(0)$?
problem.explanation: 직선 f의 방정식은 $f(x) = -3x + 30$이다(기울기 -3, y절편 30은 그래프에서 x=0일 때의 값을 읽으면 확인된다). $f(0)$은 x=0일 때의 함숫값, 즉 y절편이므로 그래프에서 직선이 y축과 만나는 점의 y좌표를 읽으면 된다. 그래프에서 직선은 (0, 30)을 지나므로 $f(0) = 30$이다.
problem.explanationEn: The line f has equation $f(x) = -3x + 30$ (slope -3, y-intercept 30, which can be confirmed by reading the graph at x = 0). Since $f(0)$ is the function value when x = 0, it is simply the y-intercept — the point where the line crosses the y-axis. The graph shows the line passing through (0, 30), so $f(0) = 30$.
